raw_text: DFRAC Analysis: The drone footage claiming to show Indian soldiers crossing the LoC is manipulated. Our forensic examination identified frame-rate inconsistencies (switching between 24fps and 30fps), EXIF metadata pointing to stock footage provider Shutterstock, and pixel-level artifacts around the inserted military figures consistent with video compositing software.
clean_text: DFRAC forensic analysis confirms LoC crossing drone footage is manipulated. Frame-rate inconsistencies, stock footage EXIF metadata, and compositing artifacts identified.
